summary: Iteration 13 — Retested the WATH Carnival over-booking regression fix from iteration_12. All 5 regression tests pass. Two-phase try_reserve_slot + unique index on wath_slot_counts(carnival_id,date,time) correctly prevents over-booking under real concurrency (asyncio.gather via httpx.AsyncClient).
critical_code_review_comments: try_reserve_slot creates the unique index on every call via best-effort try/except — functionally correct and idempotent, but noisy. Consider moving create_index into a startup hook so the first request isn't paying the cost and errors aren't silently swallowed.

release_slot decrements booked_count on insert failure but does not decrement below 0 (guarded by $gt:0) — correct. However, if the scholarship_applications.insert_one raises AFTER the 8-digit application_no was already reserved via a prior find_one, no ledger cleanup is done for the app_no probe (harmless).
iteration_12 code review comments still apply for the WATH.jsx modal fallback (not re-tested this iteration per instructions).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_OVERBOOK_* carnivals and TEST_-prefixed applicants; every carnival is DELETEd in finally blocks. Applicants are removed transitively via DELETE carnival (wath_slot_counts cascade); however scholarship_applications rows with the TEST_ email prefix remain in the DB — harmless and easily purged by prefix filter.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite for over-booking lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration13_overbook_regression.py. Covers: (1) seeded carnival hydration sanity, (2) sequential capacity=1 -> 200 then 409 with 8-digit application_no assertion, (3) 5 concurrent to capacity=1 slot via asyncio.gather/httpx.AsyncClient -> exactly 1×200 + 4×409, (4) 10 concurrent to capacity=3 slot -> exactly 3×200 + 7×409 with booked_count=3, (5) cross-carnival unique-index isolation. Note: ScholarshipApplicationIn requires `city` — earlier iterations may have missed this in test payloads. All tests self-clean their TEST_OVERBOOK_* carnivals. Prior iteration_12 UI review points (WATH.jsx modal in carnival mode) are still open but out of scope for this iteration.
rca of the issue: Fix verified. The iteration_12 RCA (upsert=True on a full-slot filter inserted a duplicate counter doc, silently permitting infinite over-books) is resolved by iteration_13's two-phase strategy in /app/backend/wath_carnival.py:189 try_reserve_slot: (1) idempotent unique index on wath_slot_counts(carnival_id,date,time); (2) find_one_and_update on existing row with $lt capacity guard (no upsert); (3) fallback insert_one on first booking; (4) DuplicateKeyError branch re-runs step 2. Under 5-way and 10-way asyncio.gather concurrency the counts are exactly at capacity (1 and 3 respectively), and booked_count/available are correctly reflected in GET /api/admin/wath/carnivals/{id} and GET /api/wath/carnivals/{id}.
